name: Black Tourmaline (Schorl) with Quartz on Feldspar
description:
Clear quartz points rise from a bed of creamy white feldspar, with black tourmaline (schorl) crystals scattered across its stepped faces. At 11.2 lb, this natural specimen makes a substantial display piece. Each side shows a different arrangement of glassy quartz, ridged feldspar and slender black crystals.

Condition and care
Some edges show wear, and loose crystals can shed during handling. Minor crystal loss is possible. Choose a sturdy, permanent display spot and handle the specimen as little as possible. The price reflects its condition.

In crystal traditions, black tourmaline is associated with grounding, protection and emotional strength. Clear quartz is traditionally paired with it to amplify those qualities.
